name: geocrm
description: Use GeoTech ONE GeoCRM boards from Codex with per-user OAuth and live board permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Work with your permitted GeoCRM boards.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to GeoTech ONE GeoCRM using your Google account. GeoCRM applies live view-only or edit access for every board and every tool call.
